info.name: RJ Thrift Hub Payments and AI API
info.description: Express API collection. Uses the deployed Render API by default. Add a valid RJ Thrift Hub JWT to the token collection variable before running protected requests. Checkout stores the returned order ID for the payment requests. Maya webhook signing values must be generated by the backend/Maya; they are not fabricated here.

variable.description: Paste the raw JWT/access token issued by your RJ Thrift Hub login API. Do not include the word Bearer.
Automatically populated from a successful Create Maya checkout response.
Use a new unique value when intentionally creating a new checkout rather than retrying the same idempotent request.
A real signature generated according to the webhook verification logic; do not invent this value.
The timestamp corresponding to the signed webhook request, in the format required by your backend.

request.description: Public health check. No bearer token is sent.

exec: pm.test('API health returns HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) {
let body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { console.error('Health response was not valid JSON:', e); }
pm.test('API status is ok', function () { pm.expect(body.data && body.data.status).to.eql('ok'); });

request.description: Requires a valid bearer token and a saved orderId from Create Maya checkout.

exec: const token = pm.collectionVariables.get('token');
const orderId = pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId');
if (!token || !String(token).trim()) { console.error('Request not sent: set a valid token first.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
if (!orderId || !String(orderId).trim()) { console.error('Request not sent: run Create Maya checkout successfully first so orderId is populated.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.test('Payment reconciliation returned a successful HTTP status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(200, 299); });
if (pm.response.code < 200 || pm.response.code >= 300) { console.error('Payment reconciliation failed:', pm.response.code, pm.response.text()); }

request.description: Public webhook endpoint; intentionally sends no bearer token. Requires a genuine signature/timestamp matching the backend's webhook verification algorithm and the actual Maya event payload.

exec: const signature = pm.collectionVariables.get('mayaWebhookSignature');
const timestamp = pm.collectionVariables.get('mayaWebhookTimestamp');
const orderId = pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId');
if (!signature || !String(signature).trim()) { console.error('Webhook not sent: set a genuine mayaWebhookSignature first.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
if (!timestamp || !String(timestamp).trim()) { console.error('Webhook not sent: set the matching mayaWebhookTimestamp first.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
if (!orderId || !String(orderId).trim()) { console.error('Webhook not sent: run checkout first and provide a real payment event for that order.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.test('Maya webhook returned a successful HTTP status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(200, 299); });
if (pm.response.code < 200 || pm.response.code >= 300) { console.error('Maya webhook failed:', pm.response.code, pm.response.text()); }
